text: Ducati is one of the Audi Group's brands (the Audi Group comprises Audi, Bentley, Lamborghini, Ducati and Audi Sport GmbH).
short: Ducati is a brand of the Audi Group.

source.name: AUDI AG (audi.com): Audi Group - A strong alliance
source.quote: The Audi Group comprises Audi, Bentley, two traditional Italian brands Lamborghini and Ducati, and Audi Sport GmbH.
source.note: The page is undated (page footer 'As of: 08/31/2026' on its images album).

additionalSources.name: Volkswagen Group (volkswagen-group.com): Group page
additionalSources.quote: The Group comprises ten brands from five European countries: Volkswagen, Volkswagen Commercial Vehicles, ŠKODA, SEAT, CUPRA, Audi, Lamborghini, Bentley, Porsche and Ducati.
additionalSources.note: The Volkswagen Group's own overview lists Ducati among its ten brands.
